title: cherry tomato & rosemary confit
ingredients: Freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 250-275°F using the convection setting.
In a small baking dish, combine the olive oil, sliced garlic, red pepper flakes, a few cracks of black pepper, a pinch of salt, and the rosemary sprigs.
Add the cherry tomatoes and gently toss until they are coated in the seasoned oil.
Roast for at least 2 hours, or until the tomatoes are very soft and beginning to burst.
Remove the rosemary sprigs and strip the leaves back into the confit, discarding the woody stems.
Taste and adjust the seasoning with additional salt and pepper if needed.
Transfer the tomatoes and all of the oil into a clean mason jar for storage.
notes: Store refrigerated in a sealed mason jar. The flavorful oil is excellent for bread, pasta, vegetables, or as a finishing oil. Always keep the tomatoes submerged in the oil during storage.
